_note: Color-score weights for the on-device V0 NN. Compose: score = w_b*B + w_g*G + w_r*R + bias. Pixels with score > score_floor contribute to the soft-argmax centroid. Tuned 2026-04-30 to favor saturated orange (R high, some G, very little B) over pure red (which the original W_R=1/W_G=-0.4 weights wrongly preferred). Edit via the GUI's NN-weight sliders or this file directly; rebuild the blob with stewart_vision/scripts/build_v0_blob.py to apply.
